# Suren Hakobyan

> Senior Frontend Engineer (React, TypeScript, Next.js, Vue) based in Yerevan, Armenia, working remotely. Builds the hard part of product UI: canvas editors, node-based workflow builders and AI features in production. Works agent-first every day with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, MCP servers and CLIs. Currently at Toptal; previously JobLeads, Simplified, ENKE Systems (Warner Music Group, Empire) and Picsart (founding frontend engineer on the Photo Editor).

Contact: surhak96@gmail.com

## Case studies

- [Toptal: ATS workflow builder](https://surhak.vercel.app/projects/toptal): node-based workflow builder (React Flow), GraphQL dashboards, design system
- [JobLeads: AI resume product, then growth frontend](https://surhak.vercel.app/projects/jobleads): AI Resume Builder and Review, SEO, A/B tests, 90+ Lighthouse
- [Simplified: AI photo/video/audio editor](https://surhak.vercel.app/projects/simplified): Canvas with Fabric.js, real-time processing, WebSocket collaboration
- [Picsart: Creative Photo Editor from line one](https://surhak.vercel.app/projects/picsart): Canvas with Konva.js, 400M+ user product, WeChat mini-apps
